'
78 Jumping Summer Carnival
(
'78ジャンピング・サマー・カーニバル
,
Nanajū-hachi Janpingu Samā Kānibaru
)
is the fifth
live album
by Japanese duo
Pink Lady
. Recorded live at
Korakuen Stadium
on July 23, 1978, the album was released on September 5, 1978. With over 100,000 fans in attendance, it was the largest concert headlined by the duo.
[
1
]
[
2
]
The album peaked at No. 12 on
Oricon
's weekly albums chart and sold over 48,000 copies.
